target.approvedName: hydroxy-delta-5-steroid dehydrogenase, 3 beta- and steroid delta-isomerase 2
functionDescriptions: 3-beta-HSD is a bifunctional enzyme, that catalyzes the oxidative conversion of Delta(5)-ene-3-beta-hydroxy steroid, and the oxidative conversion of ketosteroids. The 3-beta-HSD enzymatic system plays a crucial role in the biosynthesis of all classes of hormonal steroids. .
